subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After verifying the Blacksmith v1.10.0 SHA and final-head checks, should these 14 executable action updates land as one group across the secret-bearing and release workflows?
rationale: The patch appears mechanically correct, but accepting grouped upstream code changes across credential, publishing, scanning, and agent workflows is an explicit security and rollback-scope decision that automation should not make under the protected `security` label.

options.title: Verify and land together
options.body: Confirm every SHA against its official tag and merge the group after all relevant final-head workflow checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, Docker login/build, CodeQL, and Blacksmith updates for narrower review and rollback scope.

options.title: Regenerate later
options.body: Close or replace the group if Dependabot cannot keep the branch current or exact-head validation remains unstable.

recommendation.title: Verify and land together
recommendation.body: Confirm every SHA against its official tag and merge the group after all relevant final-head workflow checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans both Codex-agent workflow ownership and repository-wide GitHub Action runtime modernization.
